login.deviceRemoved: Le divayisi isusiwe ku-akhawunti yakho, ngakho iphumile futhi idatha yayo yasendaweni isuliwe. Ngena ukuze uyisethe futhi.

wipe.title: Susa amaphrofayela asendaweni
wipe.warning: Lokhu kuzosusa yonke imininingwane egciniwe yasendaweni, okhiye, nama-akhawunti alondoloziwe kule divayisi. I-akhawunti yakho ekude ayithinteki.

secretKey.warnIntro: Uzonikezwa Ukhiye Oyimfihlo — okuwukuphela kwendlela yokungena kudivayisi entsha ngaphandle kokufinyelela kweyodwa esivele ikhona.
secretKey.warnOnce: Ukhonjiswa <emph>kanye</emph> futhi awulokothi ugcinwe. Uma uwulahlekelwa futhi ulahlekelwe yiwo wonke amadivayisi, i-akhawunti ayisoze yabuyiswa.
secretKey.warnPrepare: Vula isiphathi samaphasiwedi, noma ulungele ukuwuphrinta noma ukuwubhala phansi endaweni ephephile.
secretKey.showSubtitle: Lokhu kulondoloze endaweni ephephile. Ngeke uphinde ukubone.
secretKey.confirmSubtitle: Namathisela ukhiye osanda kuwulondoloza ukuze ubonise ukuthi ungawuthola.

emergencyKit.document:
POLLIS — IKHITHI YEZIMO EZIPHUTHUMAYO
=====================================

Ukhiye Oyimfihlo wakho uwukuphela kwendlela yokubuyisa ukufinyelela
ku-akhawunti yakho kusuka kudivayisi entsha uma ungenayo enye
idivayisi ye-Pollis. Wuphathe njengephasiwedi enkulu.

Uma ulahlekelwa yilo khiye FUTHI ulahlekelwe ukufinyelela kuwo wonke
amadivayisi akho, i-akhawunti yakho ayisoze yabuyiswa. I-Pollis
ayikwazi ukukusethela yona kabusha.

  UKHIYE OYIMFIHLO:

    {{secretKey}}

Gcina leli fayela endaweni ephephile (isiphathi samaphasiwedi,
isipele esibethelwe, noma liphrintwe futhi likhiyelwe). Noma ubani
onalo khiye + ikheli lakho le-imeyili angangena njengawe kudivayisi
entsha.

Kwenziwe: {{generated}}

pinCreate.headline: Setha i-PIN
pinCreate.subline: Amadijithi angu-4. Uzoyisebenzisa ukuvula i-Pollis kule divayisi.

enroll.title: Gunyaza le divayisi ukuze uyengeze ku-akhawunti yakho
enroll.approveHint: Uzobona ikhodi yokuqinisekisa lapha. Vula i-Pollis kudivayisi osuvele ungene kuyo bese uqinisekisa ikhodi.
enroll.useSecretKey: Sebenzisa Ukhiye Oyimfihlo wami esikhundleni salokho
enroll.useSecretKeyHint: Okwesikhathi lapho ungenayo enye idivayisi ye-Pollis.
enroll.awaitingIntro: Vula i-Pollis kwenye idivayisi esivele ingenile. Uzobona isicelo esikucela ukuthi uqinisekise le khodi:
enroll.rejectedBody: Enye yamadivayisi akho yenqabe lokhu kubhalisa. Uma kungewona wena, shintsha iphasiwedi ye-imeyili yakho ngokushesha.
enroll.expiredBody: Isikhathi semizuzu eyi-10 sokuvuma sidlulile. Ungaqala isicelo esisha.

recover.intro: Namathisela Ukhiye Oyimfihlo osuka kuKhithi Yezimo Eziphuthumayo yakho.
recover.hint: Ukubuyisa kungathatha imizuzwana embalwa ngenkathi le divayisi ibhaliswa.
recover.wantReset: Ngilahlekelwe Ukhiye Oyimfihlo wami — setha kabusha i-akhawunti yami

reset.title: Setha kabusha le akhawunti
reset.body: Imilayezo yakho kule divayisi izosulwa unomphela. Uzophuma emaqenjini akho (abaphathi bangakumema futhi) futhi amadivayisi akho amanye azophuma.
reset.keepNote: Uzogcina i-imeyili yakho negama lakho lomsebenzisi, futhi Ukhiye Oyimfihlo omusha uzokhonjiswa kanye. Wulondoloze endaweni ephephile — uma uwulahla, ukuphela kwendlela yokubuyela ngaphakathi ukwenza konke lokhu futhi.
reset.acknowledge: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi yonke imilayezo yami izosuswa kule divayisi futhi ngizosuswa kuwo wonke amaqembu ami nezingxoxo zami.

approval.title: Idivayisi entsha ifuna ukubhalisa
approval.body: Idivayisi ethi ingeyakho (i-id {{deviceId}}) isanda kungena nge-imeyili yakho futhi icela ukwengezwa ku-akhawunti yakho.
approval.instruction: Vuma kuphela uma uqale lokhu kwenye idivayisi manje nje. Funda ikhodi esikrinini sedivayisi ENTSHA bese uyibhala ngezansi — ungayikopishi kwenye indawo. Uma amakhodi engafani, yenqaba lesi sicelo.
approval.codeHint: Izinhlamvu ezingu-{{count}}. Izinhlamvu zamagama namadijithi kuphela; u-O, u-I, u-L no-U abalokothi bavele.

shell.signOutQuestion: Ingabe ufuna ukususa imilayezo nokhiye bakho abagcinwe kule divayisi?

link.scanIntro: Kudivayisi yakho engenile, vula okuthi Ukuphepha bese uthepha okuthi Xhuma idivayisi entsha.
link.codeIntro: Kopisha ikhodi kudivayisi yakho engenile, bese uyinamathisela lapha.
link.failed: Leyo khodi ayisebenzanga. Thola entsha bese uzama futhi.
link.awaitingIntro: Thepha okuthi Vuma kudivayisi ekhombise ikhodi.
link.qrIntro: Efonini yakho engenile, vula i-Pollis bese uthepha isihlangu esisebheni samathebhu (noma uye kokuthi Ukuphepha → Skena ukuze ungenise idivayisi), bese ukhomba ikhamera kule khodi.
link.qrFailed: Ayikwazanga ukukhombisa ikhodi yokungena. Zama futhi.
link.qrAlt: Ikhodi yokungena ukuze ifoni yakho iyiskene
link.pasteHeading: Noma unamathisele ikhodi esuka kudivayisi yakho engenile
